errors: Cuts forward cover 60%->40% while the de-escalation driving the ruble is revocable (opposite of the reference hedge)
Fixes 30-40% of ruble debt for ~12m at peak rates although the CBR path implies easing in 2027
Draws 20% of credit lines early at ~16-17% with no stated need
Keeps a single payment channel, taking the ~100% national-currency claim at face value (reference trap)
P1.retrieval_gap: Mixed: the sanctions/geopolitics, logistics and customs stories were missing, but the main damage came from wrong reasoning on rates and hedging using items it did have (A1081, A0825).

errors: Misreads A0826 (713 trucks turned back for missing QR codes) as congestion/backlog and misses the QR compliance fix
Raises the China shipment plan on macro bilateral-trade headlines (A0823, A0455) with no company demand signal
P2.retrieval_gap: Mostly retrieval: A0366 (state intervention buying) and port-blockage details were missing, which undersized the wheat forward; the QR misread and the dismissed Italy and Uzbek angles were reasoning errors.

errors: Freezes and defends its own promo/ranking terms instead of fixing seller opt-out and quantity caps before FAS scrutiny
P3.retrieval_gap: Mostly retrieval: A0182, A0478, the A0025 courts angle and A0998 were absent or only one-line items, so the advertising-claim, vendor-breach and tax pieces were missed; the core items were handled reasonably.

errors: Explicitly keeps the alert level unchanged despite pre-patch public PHP details and the Kremlin sabotage warning to Germany
P4.retrieval_gap: Mainly reasoning: the items covered most reference stories (PHP, A0247, A1025, A0807, A0691, A0305); Iran-related threat items were missing, but the shortfall was the choice not to raise posture or ask vendors for attestation.

errors: Treats A0826 truck returns as temporary congestion of unknown cause instead of a QR-code paperwork failure
Spends a priority decision on Estonian crossings, which are off this forwarder's China-KZ-RU/Caspian lanes
P5.retrieval_gap: Both: refinery-strike, diesel-ban and EU 22nd-package details were missing (retrieval), while the QR misread and the Caspian risk left at monitor-only were reasoning failures.

errors: Keeps all stores outside central Paris/Lyon/Lille trading normally on 24 Oct, although Marseille, Bordeaux, Toulouse and Limoges were hit on 17 Oct
P6.retrieval_gap: Mainly reasoning: retrieval was strong; the gaps were leaving pay/labour action and Italy travel at monitor-only and leaving out the other affected cities.

main_failure_modes: Wrong direction on financial levers (P1 cuts hedges and fixes rates at the peak)
Misreading A0826 (QR-code rejections) as congestion in P2 and P5
Moving important issues to monitor-only instead of acting (pay/labour, Caspian, alert level)
Retrieval missed second-tier stories (sanctions, state grain buying, vendor breaches), which narrowed coverage
Rule-checklist framing produced spurious 'direction checks' that justified inaction
